grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Mei's Weekend Plans
instructions: 听录音，回答8个问题。题目为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
transcript:
Mei: Hi, Tom. How was your weekend?
Tom: It was good. I was at home. I was tired. And you?
Mei: My weekend was busy. I was at the park with my family.
Tom: Nice. What are you going to do next weekend?
Mei: I am going to visit my grandmother. She was sick last week.
Tom: I am sorry. Is she OK now?
Mei: Yes, she is fine. I am going to cook lunch for her because she likes noodles.
Tom: That is kind. I am going to play football because I love sports.
Mei: Good. I am going to go home now because I am hungry.
Tom: OK. See you!

grammar.title: Past tense 'was/were' and 'be going to' for future plans
grammar.explanation: 我们用 'was' 和 'were' 谈论过去。'I/he/she/it' 用 'was'，'you/we/they' 用 'were'。我们用 'be going to' 谈论计划。'be' 动词要变化：I am, you are, he/she/it is, we/they are。'because' 用来表示原因。
grammar.example: I was at the park with my family. I am going to visit my grandmother because she likes noodles.

options: I am going to play football because I love sports.
I am going to play football because I loved sports.
I am going to play football because I am love sports.
answers: I am going to play football because I love sports.
questions.explanation: 表示原因时，'because' 后面用一般现在时。
questions.evidence: I am going to play football because I love sports.
